record.sql:
SELECT
      (SELECT MAX(pulled_at) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.injury_snapshots` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS injury,
      (SELECT MAX(pulled_at) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.weather` WHERE game_id IN
         (SELECT game_id FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.schedules` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2)) AS weather,
      (SELECT MAX(pulled_at) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.odds_snapshots` WHERE
         SAFE_CAST(start_time AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP('2026-09-20 17:00:00+00') AND
         SAFE_CAST(start_time AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP('2026-09-21 00:00:00+00')) AS odds,
      (SELECT MAX(SAFE_CAST(snapshot_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.prop_lines` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS props

WITH games AS (SELECT game_id FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.schedules` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2
        AND gameday='2026-09-20' AND gametime BETWEEN '13:00' AND '16:30'),
      w AS (SELECT game_id,MAX(pulled_at) latest FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.weather` WHERE game_id IN (SELECT game_id FROM games) GROUP BY game_id)
      SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games) games,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w WHERE latest>=TIMESTAMP('2026-09-19 13:00:00+00')) weather,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.odds_snapshots`
          WHERE pulled_at>=TIMESTAMP('2026-09-19 14:00:00+00')
          AND SAFE_CAST(start_time AS TIMESTAMP)>=TIMESTAMP('2026-09-20 17:00:00+00')
          AND SAFE_CAST(start_time AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP('2026-09-21 00:00:00+00')) odds,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.prop_lines` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2
          AND SAFE_CAST(snapshot_ts AS TIMESTAMP)>=TIMESTAMP('2026-09-19 14:30:00+00')
          AND commence_time>=TIMESTAMP('2026-09-20 17:00:00+00')
          AND commence_time<TIMESTAMP('2026-09-21 00:00:00+00')) props
